{{recipe}}

'''Fried unripe plantain''' is prepared from unripe plantain, hence the name '''green plantain'''. It is served with fried yam, egg sauce or fried potatoes.

==Ingredients==
*Unripe [[Cookbook:Plantain|plantain]], peeled
*Ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Vegetable oil]]

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] unripe plantain into small rounds, then season with ground pepper and salt to taste.
#Heat enough vegetable oil in a pan for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep-frying]].
#Deep-fry plantain, ensuring all sides are golden and cooked.
#Remove from oil, and serve hot with fried yam and egg sauce.
